items.title: IonQ Announces First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.snippet: Raises full year 2026 revenue expectations to between $260 million and $270 million; second-quarter revenue guidance between $65 million and $68 million; says demand for Fifth-Generation Tempo remains strong.

items.title: IonQ Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
items.snippet: Reported $130.0 million of annual revenue for 2025 and said it expects continued momentum to achieve $235 million in revenue for 2026 at its current guidance midpoint.

items.title: 2025 Annual Report
items.snippet: SEC annual report includes risk/disclosure discussion tied to assumptions about future revenue growth rates and valuation of acquired technology intangible assets.
